mechanism_and_quality_notes: Actual saved1200x630 and320px inspected. A single radial paper commons has explicit Paper, Code and Data front leaves, two differentiated critique cutouts, a claim withdrawn into a physical pocket, and paired rerun shapes with a headless comparison brace. The data-to-rerun arrow ends at the folded sheet edge; the critique arrow ends in the withdrawal pocket. Null results count is printed directly on the lower-right leaf, rather than leaving it blank. Detached caveat distinguishes file agreement from methodological validity. No invented numeric finding, code, people or success mark. Foreground measured x95..1105,y68..582; every glyph is inside that envelope and meets40px safety. Paper relief with open captions is visibly different from the indigo engraved shell. At320px the manuscript/artifact/rerun/withdrawal distinction and priority labels remain readable; small paper grain is full-size detail.  Actual six-up and all fifteen same-set pairs have now been inspected; source mechanism, material and dominant silhouette differ.
